grammar.label: present perfect — just / already / yet
grammar.form: have just + PP; have already + PP; haven't … yet; Have you … yet?
grammar.meaning: recent past with a present result

explanation.en: just = a moment ago; already = sooner than expected; yet = up to now, in questions and negatives.
explanation.uz: just = hozirgina; already = kutilganidan oldin; yet = hozirgacha (savol va inkorda, gap oxirida).

l1_notes.uz: 'yet' gap OXIRIDA, 'already' va 'just' fe'ldan OLDIN keladi.

grammar.label: gone to vs been to
grammar.form: has gone to (not back yet) / has been to (came back)

explanation.en: He has gone to London = he is there now. He has been to London = he visited and came back.
explanation.uz: 'has gone to' = hozir o'sha yerda. 'has been to' = borib qaytgan.

grammar.positive_example: She has been to Bukhara three times.
grammar.negative_example: She has gone to Bukhara three times.

l1_notes.uz: Bu farq o'zbek tilida grammatik emas — alohida yodlash kerak.
